title: Where GREP Came From - Computerphile
summary: Brian Kernighan explains how grep came to be, written overnight by Ken Thompson, and how it got its name from the ed command g/re/p. He also covers the lineage from QED to ed that led to it.
why: HN commenters point to it as a short, charming first-hand account of Unix history from someone who was there.

quote.text: My favourite BWK video is about grep.
